Worth 15 minutes? I will walk you through a teardown of your current outbound and three things I would change. Our best-practice patterns alone usually lift reply rates 50-70 percent.

I pulled a benchmark of how Stampli's reply rate likely compares to other growth-stage fintechs. Want to grab time so I can walk you through it?

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your SDR motion? I will tailor it to Stampli either way.
